create_patterns.name: selection-nothing-loaded-for-implicit-clean-no-keyword.md
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded when clean is implied but the word is missing

Trace t2: 'Put soap in the sink with water to be placed on the toilet lid.' The ground truth was pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded.

The task never says clean or wash. It describes the cleaning act: an object goes in the sink with water. The clean description keys on the word 'clean', so the match failed.

Fix: the description should list implied cleaning cues, such as sink, water, rinse and scrub, alongside clean/wash. The agent should load a skill even when no trigger word matches. Offered descriptions are unchanged in this evidence.

create_patterns.name: selection-nothing-loaded-for-plural-without-two-word.md
create_patterns.content:
# Nothing loaded when the count of two is implied by a plural

Trace t4: 'Move the alarm clocks on the desk to the drawer shelf.' The ground truth was pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing was loaded.

The task has no literal 'two'. The plural noun implies two objects. The two-object description triggers on the stated count, so it was not matched.

Fix: say that a plural object noun with no number also suggests pick_two_obj_and_place. Say that a skill must be loaded when the plain pick_and_place wording does not fit a plural task.
